_: Review v16: batch 8's shots, each beside its reference from docs/art/target (copied to screens/ref). docs/review/batch8.sh makes the frames (paths under its OUT folder); docs/review/v16_apply.py turns each into a screen on the review page with two versions: the target, then ours. The b8- shots repeat batch 7's where batch 7 started before they landed (v15 has their first take, if any), and add the town look round 2 and the centrepiece at a grief and a feast. 'needs' names the harness step that frames the shot.
label: Batch 8

shots.name: Goldrock's ring streets
shots.what: Goldrock from higher (d14): two ring streets round its square and packed plots, a town not a village

shots.name: Goldrock's plots
shots.what: Goldrock at d6: narrow plots shoulder to shoulder along its streets

shots.name: The crown's market rows
shots.what: Kingsmere's stalls in rows facing the square's heart, awnings of many colours, goods heaped at their ends

shots.name: A seat's market rows
shots.what: Goldrock's stalls in rows facing its fountain

shots.name: The King on his column
shots.what: The crown's square's centrepiece close: the King standing on the brick column in the fountain's basin

shots.name: A seat's fountain
shots.what: Goldrock's fountain close: the round basin, the column and its urn

shots.name: Earth lanes
shots.what: Kingsmere's back lanes as trodden earth worn into the grass, the main streets cobbled or rutted

shots.name: Goldrock's lanes
shots.what: Goldrock's back lanes, earth with soft edges

shots.name: Orchards at the edge
shots.what: Blocks of fruit trees in rows just past Kingsmere's edge, square to a road out

shots.name: Wheat by the windmill
shots.what: Wheat fields laid round Goldrock's windmill outside the edge

shots.name: Washing in the yards
shots.what: Kingsmere's yards from above: washing lines with white, blue-grey, rose and ochre hangings in about one yard in four

shots.name: Houses beside people
shots.what: Street level at Kingsmere: a two-storey house about 8-9 m to the ridge beside 1.7 m townsfolk

shots.name: Goldrock's street
shots.what: Street level at Goldrock: house heights beside the townsfolk

shots.name: Grief at the statue
shots.what: Mourners kneeling and candles set round the basin's rim, none in the water

shots.name: A feast by the statue
shots.what: The bonfire off the heart on the seen side, the dancers and tables round it, the bunting's pole clear of the basin

shots.name: The feast, wide
shots.what: The square at feast: statue, bonfire, tables and bunting together

shots.name: Kingsmere's square, before
shots.what: The crown's market without the square's life (--crowd=off): stalls, buyers and porters only

shots.name: Kingsmere's square, after
shots.what: The square alive: a crier and his listeners, beggars at the church step, the guard's patrol round its edge, dogs, children chasing, knots of gossip

shots.name: Kingsmere's square, street level
shots.what: The fuller square from the street (d4.5)

shots.name: The castle
shots.what: The seat's castle: keep, curtain walls and towers, the lord's banners on every tower, the gatehouse

shots.name: Guards on the walls
shots.what: Guards in the lord's colours walking the wall walks, turning at the towers to look out

shots.name: The castle gate
shots.what: The gatehouse: arch, portcullis half raised, leaves open, banners either side

shots.name: The castle breached
shots.what: The castle's stone curtains under the town's wall wear: cracked, crumbling, open to the ground with rubble

shots.name: The besiegers' camp
shots.what: The camp wide: tents in the besieger's colours, cook fires, the palisade, wagons behind, the engines going up in the band, the wall beyond (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: An engine mid-throw
shots.what: A trebuchet worked by its crew: the arm drawn back, loaded, whipping over, the stone away on its arc (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: A stone hitting the wall
shots.what: The engines' stones striking the wall: dust, stones falling, the crack band (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: The wall breach
shots.what: The stone wall opened by thrown stones: a gap to the ground and its rubble ramp (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: The wall cracking
shots.what: The wall under the first stones: the crack band, battlements chipped, dust (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: The storm through the breach
shots.what: The besiegers fight the holder's block man to man in the gap, over the rubble; the losers fall back (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: The gap taken
shots.what: The block broken and run, the besiegers in over the rubble, cheering (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: The town put to the torch
shots.what: After the storm: the town's houses catching one after another, smoke columns leaning with the wind (again: batch 7's had no wall in frame; now from outside the town)

shots.name: House arms on the men
shots.what: Close on the line (d3): the crown's arms on each man's chest and a roundel on his shield, steel elsewhere

shots.name: The soldiers, kit paint (before)
shots.what: The line close (d3) in the kit's own paint

shots.name: The soldiers, painted (after)
shots.what: The same frame painted: steel reads as steel from the shadow side, darker hem and collar, feet grounded, no clones

shots.name: Each house's colours
shots.what: Painted regiments in each house's colours: the arms crisp on shield and chest, the colour in big clean blocks

shots.name: A painted march
shots.what: The column marching (d6): per-man variation holds as they move, no swimming paint

shots.name: A painted melee
shots.what: Men at blows (d4): steel and cloth read in motion, the arms on shields turned to and from the light

shots.name: Two lines formed
shots.what: Two hosts facing in line, crown colours against a house's, banners and standards

shots.name: The volleys
shots.what: Arrows arcing between the lines, men falling under them

shots.name: The fronts meet
shots.what: The fronts at sword's length along their whole length, not a blob; cuts and reels

shots.name: Horse on the flank
shots.what: Cavalry going in on the end of the enemy line

shots.name: The rout
shots.what: Beaten banners wavering, regiments running, the fallen left behind

shots.name: The field held
shots.what: The victors at ease on the field

shots.name: Men at blows
shots.what: The fight close (d4): pairs at sword's length, cuts, parries and reels

shots.name: A battle in play
shots.what: A battle the realm fought, staged where the bridge reported it: both sides in their houses' colours, the beaten one breaking (only if this reign has had one; else the latest news)

shots.name: A host selected
shots.what: A click on the host's standard: the gold ring under it, its banner lit, the command card over the minimap

shots.name: A host's march
shots.what: The host ordered to march on a town: its dotted route across the land

shots.name: Ordering a march
shots.what: March chosen on the card and a click on the land: the route to it drawn

shots.name: Ploughing
shots.what: Spring: an ox team drawing the plough along the furrows, the ploughman behind

shots.name: Sowing
shots.what: Spring: sowers casting seed from the hip across the turned field

shots.name: Weeding
shots.what: Summer: the green rows weeded, hoed and watered

shots.name: The harvest
shots.what: Autumn: reapers cutting the gold, binders standing the sheaves in stooks

shots.name: Gleaning
shots.what: Late autumn: the stubble gleaned, the stooks carted off

shots.name: The fields round the seat
shots.what: The seat's fields in summer from higher: work in several at once

shots.name: A flock on the fallow
shots.what: A shepherd with 5-8 sheep grazing a fallow field, moving on to the next

shots.name: Kingsmere in the rain
shots.what: Rain on the seat: roofs darker and glinting, puddles on the square, half its people gone in; banners and grass leaning the way the smoke goes

shots.name: The square in the rain
shots.what: Puddles round the square, mud on the road in, the wet cobbles

shots.name: The town in the rain
shots.what: The whole town wet under a grey sky

shots.name: Kingsmere in winter
shots.what: Snow lying in patches on the roofs and on the ground, flakes falling

shots.name: The town in winter
shots.what: The whole town under snow

shots.name: The road at night
shots.what: The road out of Kingsmere by night: only a torchlit patrol or a messenger

shots.name: The castle gate at night
shots.what: The gate's two torches lit, a warm light on the stone

steps.what: Frames the n-th roadside site of a kind, from the crown's seat outward (autoplay.gd; roadside.gd sites()). play.log says where it stood, or that none of that kind stands.
Frames a trade's building in a town from the town root's works (autoplay.gd; works.gd find). play.log says where, or which trades the town has.
Frames the first open breach in a stone wall near the staged siege's front, low and oblique (the siege's front if none is open yet; autoplay.gd).
Frames the King's n-th host and clicks its standard (autoplay.gd; host_command.gd, --hosts=on). play.log says how many hosts stand.
Frames the besiegers' camp from over its tents toward the town (autoplay.gd; siege_camp.gd, --camp=on or --wall-demo).
Frames the n-th siege engine low and oblique (autoplay.gd; group siege_engines).
Holds the fields' year at a season and how far through it, and frames the n-th sown field from the crown's seat (autoplay.gd; works-life's countryside.gd hold_season).
Frames the n-th fallow field, where a shepherd's flock grazes (autoplay.gd).
Frames the town's castle low and oblique, or its gatehouse (autoplay.gd).
